items.statement: The submission documents relaxation/convergence, compares magnetic states, and explicitly samples SOC band energies at K and K-prime.
items.expected: A reproducible workflow with convergence evidence, magnetic comparison, and explicit K/K-prime SOC sampling.

items.statement: The computed VSe2 solution reports a ferromagnetic state and a positive K/K-prime valence-band splitting.
items.expected: FM ground-state assignment and positive nonzero SOC valley splitting.
